wellbeing.title: Support after an accident
wellbeing.subtitle: Practical steps and general guidance after a difficult event.
wellbeing.safe: I am in a safe place
wellbeing.safeText: Move away from traffic, fire, smoke, cables, moving water, or other hazards. Do not put yourself at risk to help.
wellbeing.steps: What to do after an accident
wellbeing.stepsText: Check whether anyone needs immediate help. Do not move an injured person unless there is direct danger.
wellbeing.contactText: Share your location and condition with someone you trust. For immediate emergencies call 9-1-1.
wellbeing.emotionalText: Seek company, allow time to recover, and consult professionals if symptoms persist or worsen.
wellbeing.notice: PULSE AI does not replace medical or psychological care and does not diagnose.
wellbeing.emergency: If there is immediate danger, serious injury, breathing difficulty, severe bleeding, or risk of self-harm, seek human help and call 9-1-1.

landing.heroTitle: Clear information and coordination when every second matters.
landing.heroText: PULSE 911 connects citizen reporting, the situation map, and operational coordination in a functional demonstration.
landing.publicPreview: Desktop view of the PULSE 911 public portal
landing.urgentTitle: Turn an urgent situation into actionable information.
landing.urgentText: The flow guides people through category, details, location, and evidence. Each step reduces ambiguity before sending the case to the command center.
landing.mobileTitle: Response also fits in your hand.
landing.mobileText: The mobile view summarizes case status, location, and estimated time without losing the desktop portal context.
landing.commandTitle: From alert to a traceable operational decision.
landing.commandText: PULSE Command brings together the incident queue, available units, map, and case history so every action keeps its context.
landing.learningTitle: Response starts before and continues afterward.
landing.learningText: Short training, assessments, and visual resources support the community in prevention, initial response, and wellbeing.
landing.finalText: Enter as a citizen or operator and explore the complete simulation from reporting to coordination.
landing.academicNotice: Local academic environment. It does not contact real 911 services.
landing.termsText: PULSE 911 is an academic simulation. The information, incidents, and times shown are fictional and do not replace official emergency services.
landing.privacyText: This demonstration uses local and simulated data. Avoid entering personal, medical, or sensitive information during testing.
landing.course1Text: Contacts, routes, meeting points, and essential supplies.
landing.course2Text: Recognize an emergency and request help with clear information.
landing.course3Text: Listen, accompany, and connect with support networks after the event.
landing.mobileAlt: Concept mobile view of citizen tracking
